title: Generate example tines objects — example_schema
text: functions generate pre-populated `schema` `multiverse` objects. primarily designed testing, running examples documentation, helping new users explore `tines` package without build garden forking paths scratch. * `example_schema()` returns single, validated `schema` object containing   standard set nodes (steps constraints) edges. * `example_multiverse()` returns validated `multiverse` object containing   multiple variations example schema.
